entity_types.name: TalkingAnimal
entity_types.description: A non-human biological entity capable of human-like speech and advanced cognitive reasoning.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name assigned to or chosen by the animal.

attributes.name: biological_species
attributes.description: The original species of the animal.

attributes.name: speech_fluency
attributes.description: The level of linguistic and cognitive complexity demonstrated.

entity_types.name: Scientist
entity_types.description: Individual researcher specializing in evolutionary biology, linguistics, or cognitive science.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the researcher.

attributes.name: research_field
attributes.description: Primary area of scientific expertise.

attributes.name: institution_affiliation
attributes.description: The university or lab the scientist works for.

entity_types.name: GovernmentAgency
entity_types.description: National security or administrative body tasked with regulation and public order.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The official name of the agency.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_area
attributes.description: The geographic or legal scope of authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_power
attributes.description: The specific laws they enforce regarding the discovery.

entity_types.name: Corporation
entity_types.description: Commercial entity seeking to monetize the discovery through media or biotechnology.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The registered company name.

attributes.name: business_model
attributes.description: How the company intends to profit from the animal.

attributes.name: market_cap
attributes.description: The financial scale of the corporation.

entity_types.name: MediaOutlet
entity_types.description: Traditional journalism network shaping the structured national narrative.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the news organization.

attributes.name: audience_reach
attributes.description: The scale of the outlet's viewership or readership.

attributes.name: political_leaning
attributes.description: The editorial stance of the outlet.

entity_types.name: Influencer
entity_types.description: Social media personality driving viral trends and hyper-accelerating awareness.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The public name or handle of the influencer.

attributes.name: primary_platform
attributes.description: The main social media platform used.

attributes.name: follower_base
attributes.description: The size and demographic of the audience.

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individual fighting for animal rights, personhood, and legal protection.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the activist.

attributes.name: advocacy_goal
attributes.description: The specific legal or moral outcome desired.

attributes.name: protest_history
attributes.description: Previous involvement in social movements.

entity_types.name: ReligiousLeader
entity_types.description: Clerical authority providing theological interpretations of the discovery.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the religious figure.

attributes.name: religious_denomination
attributes.description: The faith tradition they represent.

attributes.name: spiritual_rank
attributes.description: The position held within the religious hierarchy.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Any natural person not categorized into specific professional or social roles.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual.

attributes.name: personal_location
attributes.description: General geographic location.

attributes.name: social_media_bio

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Any collective entity or group not categorized into specific institutional roles.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization.

attributes.name: entity_purpose
attributes.description: The general mission or reason for existence.

attributes.name: operational_scale
